subject.title: feat(session): add named new and close chat commands

question: Should OpenClaw core expose `/close` and `/delete` as chat commands that archive the active non-main session after the parser bug and proof gap are fixed?
rationale: The destructive session command surface is a product/session-state decision, and the code review can verify guards but cannot decide whether this user-facing command should be available across chat channels.

options.title: Land after parser fix and proof
options.body: Keep the command surface, require the catalog-backed `/new` fallthrough fix, current-head Telegram or equivalent chat proof, and any title/label alignment needed after related session-title work.

options.title: Defer close/delete
options.body: Keep only named `/new` work for now and ask for a separate maintainer-sponsored PR for destructive chat-side session archive commands.

options.title: Wait for title migration
options.body: Pause this PR until the canonical title migration settles, then rebase the naming write path onto the approved session naming field contract.

recommendation.title: Land after parser fix and proof
recommendation.body: Keep the command surface, require the catalog-backed `/new` fallthrough fix, current-head Telegram or equivalent chat proof, and any title/label alignment needed after related session-title work.

likelyOwner.reason: Current-main history in this checkout ties the reset-model and gateway session lifecycle paths to this owner, and the decision spans both command parsing and session lifecycle behavior.
